**brief:** a confident or maybe brief of a plain-language or weak prompt opens with a search receipt and ends on one instruction: `read:` / `also:` ranges (the best function of each of the top three files by keyword BM25, at most 60 lines) and "Read these ranges in parallel before any search. If they don't answer, search as usual."; a code-shaped prompt reads its definition, then callers. A strict "Answer from these lines" step exists but no rule is validated, so it never fires. Pasted links no longer count as code identifiers. `PIXEL_BRIEF_RECEIPT=0`, `PIXEL_BRIEF_ANSWER=0` and `PIXEL_BRIEF_ZERO=0` remove the parts.
